sections.use: Pull one section out of a Markdown document by its heading, with its subsections, for a model block or a reviewer to work on.
sections.exclusions: Only ATX headings (lines starting with #). Setext headings (underlined with = or -), headings inside block quotes or lists, HTML blocks and indented code are not recognised.
sections.limitations: Markdown up to 1 MiB. Headings inside fenced code are ignored. The heading is compared after trimming and collapsing spaces, ignoring case; the first match wins and matches counts all.
sections.missing_data: A heading that is not found gives found false, an empty section and null line numbers.
sections.effects: Runs locally inside AgentWiz with no network access, files or model; it only returns a value. It has no destination, so it can run on Local only data; its output is restricted whenever an input is.
sections.failures: A refusal names a fixed code and, where it applies, a 1-based position (record, row or entry); the message never repeats your text. Check the input against the limits above and run again.

inputs.heading: The heading text to find, without the # marks.

outputs.out: found, matches, the section text, its level and its first and last line numbers.
